verification.lab-01-operation-count:
assert pair_count(0) == 0
assert pair_count(1) == 0
assert pair_count(5) == 10
verification.lab-03-sequence-list:
items = []
insert(items, 0, 1)
insert(items, 1, 2)
assert items == [1, 2]
assert delete(items, 0) == 1 and items == [2]
for action in (lambda: insert(items, -1, 0), lambda: insert(items, 3, 0), lambda: delete(items, 1)):
    try:
        action()
        raise AssertionError('invalid index must fail')
    except IndexError:
        pass
verification.lab-04-linked-merge:
assert values(merge(None, None)) == []
assert values(merge(build([]), build([1, 1]))) == [1, 1]
assert values(merge(build([1, 3]), build([]))) == [1, 3]
merged = merge(build([1, 2, 2]), build([2, 4]))
seen = set()
node = merged
while node:
    assert id(node) not in seen
    seen.add(id(node))
    node = node.next
assert values(merged) == [1, 2, 2, 2, 4]
verification.lab-05-bracket-matching:
assert balanced('') is True
assert balanced('abc') is True
assert balanced('(') is False
assert balanced(']') is False
assert balanced('{[()]}') is True
verification.lab-07-kmp:
assert kmp('abc', '') == 0
assert kmp('abc', 'a') == 0
assert kmp('abc', 'abcd') == -1
assert kmp('aaaaa', 'aaa') == 0
assert kmp('abc', 'z') == -1
assert prefix_function('aaaa') == [0, 1, 2, 3]
verification.lab-08-sparse-transpose:
assert fast_transpose(0, 0, []) == []
assert fast_transpose(3, 4, [(2, 3, 9)]) == [(3, 2, 9)]
assert fast_transpose(3, 4, [(0, 0, 1), (2, 3, 2)]) == [(0, 0, 1), (3, 2, 2)]
verification.lab-09-tree-traversal:
assert preorder(None) == []
assert inorder_iterative(None) == []
single = Node('R')
assert preorder(single) == ['R'] and inorder_iterative(single) == ['R']
left_chain = Node(3, Node(2, Node(1)))
assert preorder(left_chain) == [3, 2, 1]
assert inorder_iterative(left_chain) == [1, 2, 3]
verification.lab-10-huffman:
assert weighted_path_length([]) == 0
assert weighted_path_length([8]) == 0
assert weighted_path_length([2, 2]) == 4
assert weighted_path_length([0, 1, 2]) == 4
try:
    weighted_path_length([1, -1])
    raise AssertionError('negative weight must fail')
except ValueError:
    pass
verification.lab-13-binary-search:
assert first_index([], 1) == -1
assert first_index([1], 1) == 0
assert first_index([1, 2, 3], 1) == 0
assert first_index([1, 2, 3], 3) == 2
assert first_index([2, 2, 2], 2) == 0
assert first_index([1, 2, 3], 4) == -1
verification.lab-14-hash-table:
full = HashTable(2)
assert full.insert(0) == 0
assert full.insert(2) == 1
assert full.insert(2) == 1
try:
    full.insert(1)
    raise AssertionError('full table must fail')
except OverflowError:
    pass
assert full.find(0) == 0 and full.find(2) == 1 and full.find(9) == -1
verification.lab-15-quick-sort:
assert quick_sort([]) == []
assert quick_sort([1]) == [1]
assert quick_sort([2, 2, 2]) == [2, 2, 2]
assert quick_sort([1, 2, 3]) == [1, 2, 3]
assert quick_sort([3, 2, 1]) == [1, 2, 3]
verification.lab-16-merge-sort:
assert merge_sort([]) == []
assert merge_sort([(1, 'A')]) == [(1, 'A')]
equal = [(1, 'A'), (1, 'B'), (1, 'C')]
assert merge_sort(equal) == equal
assert merge_sort([(2, 'A'), (1, 'B'), (2, 'C')]) == [(1, 'B'), (2, 'A'), (2, 'C')]
